messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++17 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <vector>
#include <stdexcept>

void answer(unsigned v)
{
    std::cout << v << '\n';
}

void solve(const std::vector<unsigned>& a)
{
    if (a.empty()) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("vector is empty");
    }

    const auto& [min, max] = std::minmax_element(std::begin(a), std::end(a));

    answer(*min + (*max - *min) / 2);
}

int main()
{
    size_t n;
    std::cin >> n;

    std::vector<unsigned> a(n);
    std::copy_n(std::istream_iterator<unsigned>(std::cin), std::size(a), std::begin(a));

    if (n == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("no input");
    }

    try {
        solve(a);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "Error: " << e.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
